description: The plot titled “BBQ” illustrates how accuracy varies with the number of demonstrations for several methods/models. The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 1500 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0, 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, and 1500. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and shows tick labels at 45, 50, and 55 (units not specified). A dark blue solid line with circular markers labeled “Squared-Exponential” starts near 53 at the smallest demonstration count, rises to about 56 by around 250 demonstrations, and then stays near 56 through to 1500 demonstrations with small fluctuations. A medium blue solid line with circular markers labeled “Tanh” is near 48 at the smallest demonstration count and remains around 48 across the full x-range, with a slight dip around the mid-range and returning near 48 by 1500. A lighter blue solid line with circular markers labeled “ELU” is near 46 at the smallest demonstration count and stays approximately flat around 46 through 1500 demonstrations. A pink dashed horizontal line labeled “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” sits near 43 across the entire x-range without change.
